paragraphs.en: Memory failures occur at different stages and require different remedies. Selection determines whether evidence enters memory; representation determines which details survive; retrieval determines which retained evidence reaches the policy; revision determines which information remains valid; and policy integration determines whether available evidence changes action. Increasing retrieval capacity cannot recover an event discarded at write time. Increasing storage cannot correct a policy that attends to an obsolete entry. A practical diagnostic progression is to supply the missed evidence, then supply the correct retrieved entry, and finally supply the correct current state, measuring which intervention repairs the behavior. These interventions are proposed analytical controls; they should not be confused with results already demonstrated by the reviewed systems.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆失败发生在不同阶段，需要不同的补救措施。 选择决定证据是否进入记忆；表征决定哪些细节得以保留；检索决定哪些留存下来的证据到达策略；修订决定哪些信息仍然有效；而策略整合决定可用证据是否会改变行动。 提升检索能力无法找回在写入时就被丢弃的事件。 增加存储无法纠正一个关注过时条目的策略。 一个实用的诊断递进方法是：先提供被遗漏的证据，然后提供正确的检索条目，最后提供正确的当前状态，并测量哪种干预修复了行为。 这些干预是提出的分析性控制手段；不应将其与已综述系统已演示的结果相混淆。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid memory needs an agreement mechanism as well as complementary representations. A visual frame, a task note, and a scene graph can refer to the same object while disagreeing about its current location or whether an action succeeded. Without provenance and update rules, adding stores can increase the number of mutually inconsistent beliefs. A useful hybrid should specify which observation or verified action can supersede each record, how an entity is linked across stores, and how uncertainty triggers re-observation. Component ablations should consequently test conflict resolution as well as recall: retaining an accurate old frame is compatible with making an incorrect present-state decision. The resulting design objective is coordinated maintenance of decision-relevant state under a bounded resource budget.
paragraphs.zh: 混合记忆既需要一种共识机制，也需要互补的表征。 一个视觉帧、一条任务笔记和一个场景图可以指向同一个对象，却对其当前位置或某个动作是否成功持有不一致的看法。 缺乏来源信息与更新规则时，增加存储反而可能增加彼此矛盾的信念数量。 一个有用的混合系统应当规定：何种观察或经过验证的动作可以取代每条记录、一个实体如何跨存储进行关联，以及不确定性如何触发重新观察。 因此，组件消融实验不仅应测试回忆能力，还应测试冲突消解：保留一帧准确的旧画面与做出错误的当前状态决策是可以并存的。 由此得到的设计目标，是在有限的资源预算下对与决策相关的状态进行协同维护。

paragraphs.en: Cross-episode improvement requires an explicit persistence and transfer protocol. A7 describes an organization for reusable experience, but its name does not establish that any particular experiment retains state between episodes. Every method should report what is reset, what persists, whether the base policy changes, and which test conditions differ from the stored cases. Retrieval can improve a new episode through a close match without learning a reusable rule; consolidation can produce a concise rule that fails when its applicability conditions change. Evidence for sustained improvement therefore requires held-out situations, conflicting or obsolete experience, and comparison with a frozen archive under matched interaction budgets. This separates benefits of a growing memory from benefits of repeated exposure or continued policy training.
paragraphs.zh: 跨情节的改进需要显式的持久化与迁移协议。 A7 描述了一种可复用经验的组织方式，但其名称并不能说明任何具体实验会在情节之间保留状态。 每种方法都应报告哪些内容被重置、哪些内容被保留、基础策略是否发生改变，以及哪些测试条件与已存储的案例不同。 检索可以通过一次接近的匹配改进新情节而不学习任何可复用的规则；巩固可以产出一个简洁的规则，但其适用条件发生变化时该规则会失效。 因此，持续改进的证据需要在留出情境、冲突或过时经验上进行验证，并与冻结的档案在相同的交互预算下进行比较。 这将不断增长的记忆所带来的收益与重复暴露或持续策略训练所带来的收益区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We therefore examine benchmarks along two complementary axes. The first is the control level at which historical information is consumed: high-level planning, hierarchical whole-stack execution, low-level visuomotor control, or dedicated memory evaluation. The second is memory diagnosticity : how directly benchmark success can be attributed to historical information that the agent itself must preserve, update, and later use.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们从两个互补的维度来考察这些基准测试。 第一个维度是控制层级，即历史信息在哪个层级被消费：高层规划、分层式全栈执行、低层视觉运动控制，或专门的记忆评估。 第二个维度是记忆诊断性：即基准测试的成功在多大程度上能直接归因于智能体自身必须保存、更新并随后使用的历史信息。

paragraphs.en: We use memory diagnosticity to describe how directly a benchmark isolates behavior that depends on information no longer available in the current observation, rather than on trajectory length or general task difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用记忆诊断性（memory diagnosticity）来描述一个基准在多大程度上直接隔离出依赖于当前观察中已不可得信息的行为，而非依赖于轨迹长度或一般任务难度。

paragraphs.en: High-level evaluations score the use of observations to choose actions or answers, with much of motor execution supplied by the interface. EmbodiedBench [ 102 ] presents visual observations and instructions, executes the model’s selected actions, and reports task completion across its environment and capability subsets. Its high-level household tasks primarily test grounding and sub-goal choice through semantic actions, whereas its lower-level environments impose a different action burden. ESI-Bench [ 103 ] evaluates final-answer accuracy after observation gathering, comparing a single view, active multi-view inputs, active exploration, and oracle-trajectory views. This comparison helps distinguish obtaining useful evidence from reasoning over supplied evidence, although both can depend on retained history. EMem-Bench [ 104 ] supplies prior interaction histories before subsequent embodied execution; Sec. 5.3.1 examines its protocol. These interfaces make history-conditioned planning or reasoning accessible to study, while success remains sensitive to perception, action selection, and the information provided externally.
paragraphs.zh: 高层评估侧重于评分如何利用观测来选择动作或答案，而大部分运动执行由接口提供。 EmbodiedBench [102] 提供视觉观测与指令，执行模型选择的动作，并报告其环境与能力子集上的任务完成情况。 其高层家庭任务主要通过语义动作测试接地与子目标选择，而其低层环境则带来不同的动作负担。 ESI-Bench [103] 评估观测收集后的最终答案准确性，比较单一视角、主动多视角输入、主动探索以及神谕轨迹视角。 这种比较有助于区分获取有用证据与对所提供证据进行推理，尽管两者都可能依赖于保留的历史记录。 EMem-Bench [104] 在后续具身执行之前提供先前的交互历史；第 5.3.1 节考察了其协议。 这些接口使得以历史为条件的规划或推理易于研究，而成功仍然对感知、动作选择以及外部提供的信息敏感。

paragraphs.en: Hierarchical evaluations must expose how much progress information is supplied to the planner. RoboCerebra [ 105 ] couples a high-level planner to a lower-level policy and reports state-transition completion, exact plan agreement, plan efficiency, and action-completion interpretation. Its state-transition measure credits satisfied key conditions, so it should not be conflated with binary full-episode success; its anchor-based planner comparison also supplies transition structure. BEHAVIOR-1K [ 106 ] evaluates physically executed household goals whose satisfaction depends on object states and relations. For memory analysis, the important protocol variables are the permitted observations and the source of task-state information: simulator predicates may legitimately score completion while remaining unavailable to the policy. Task success under onboard sensing has strong deployment relevance but combines navigation, control, grounding, and historical state. Authors should identify the observation regime and distinguish evaluator access to ground truth from policy access before treating either suite as evidence of memory.
paragraphs.zh: 分层评估必须揭示向规划器提供了多少进度信息。 RoboCerebra [ 105 ] 将高层规划器与低层策略耦合，并报告状态转移完成度、精确计划一致率、计划效率以及动作完成度解读。 其状态转移度量会对满足的关键条件计分，因此不应与二元的整回合成功相混淆；其基于锚点的规划器比较还提供了转移结构。 BEHAVIOR-1K [ 106 ] 评估实际执行的家庭目标，这些目标的达成取决于物体状态与物体间关系。 对于记忆分析而言，重要的协议变量是允许的观测以及任务状态信息的来源：模拟器谓词可以合理地用于评判完成度，同时对策略而言仍不可用。 在机载感知下的任务成功具有很强的部署相关性，但它混合了导航、控制、定位 grounding 和历史状态。 作者应明确观测体制，并在将任一基准套件视为记忆的证据之前，区分评估器对真值 ground truth 的访问与策略的访问。

sents.zh: 分层评估必须揭示向规划器提供了多少进度信息。

sents.zh: RoboCerebra [ 105 ] 将高层规划器与低层策略耦合，并报告状态转移完成度、精确计划一致率、计划效率以及动作完成度解读。

sents.en: For memory analysis, the important protocol variables are the permitted observations and the source of task-state information: simulator predicates may legitimately score completion while remaining unavailable to the policy.

sents.en: Authors should identify the observation regime and distinguish evaluator access to ground truth from policy access before treating either suite as evidence of memory.

paragraphs.en: Low-level evaluations measure whether remembered information can be converted into successful robot motion. Language-conditioned suites such as LIBERO, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and VLABench commonly report rollout success under task-specific goal predicates [ 107 , 108 , 109 , 110 ] . Such scores jointly depend on choosing the correct target and realizing the required physical interaction. CALVIN [ 111 ] adds instruction chains: completion rates for successive subtasks and average chain length measure reliable composition, while the evaluator’s successive instructions supply part of procedural state. RoboCasa365 [ 112 ] additionally distinguishes multi-task, foundation-model, and lifelong-learning settings; sequential-training retention measures a different process from persistence of observations within a deployment episode. Dedicated memory subsets make the history variable clearer, but a failed grasp can still mask correct recall. RoboDojo [ 113 ] is particularly useful here because its Memory and Long-Horizon splits are separate and its partial-progress score complements binary success; Sec. 5.3.2 examines the Memory protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 低层评测衡量被记住的信息能否转化为成功的机器人运动。 语言条件化评测套件如 LIBERO、RoboCasa、RoboTwin 2.0 和 VLABench 通常在任务特定的目标谓词下报告执行成功率 [ 107 , 108 , 109 , 110 ] 。 这些得分同时取决于选择正确的目标以及完成所需的物理交互。 CALVIN [ 111 ] 增加了指令链：用连续子任务的完成率和平均链长来衡量可靠的组合能力，而评估器给出的连续指令则提供了部分过程性状态。 RoboCasa365 [ 112 ] 还进一步区分多任务、基础模型和终身学习设定；顺序训练的保持度衡量的是与单个部署回合内观测持久性不同的过程。 专门的记忆子集使历史变量更加清晰，但一次失败的抓取仍可能掩盖正确的记忆。 RoboDojo [ 113 ] 在这一点上尤其有用，因为它的 Memory 和 Long-Horizon 划分是分开的，且其部分进展得分补充了二元成功指标；第 5.3.2 节将考察 Memory 协议。

paragraphs.en: A benchmark metric has meaning only together with its observation interface and completion rule. Table 3 makes these elements explicit for representative general benchmarks. The evaluation target column describes the competence jointly tested by the rollout, whereas the last column states what remains unresolved about historical dependence. In particular, a goal-predicate success rate, a chain-completion measure, an answer-accuracy score, and a partial-progress score should retain their distinct meanings even when each is reported as a percentage. Their aggregation also matters: weighting tasks equally and weighting capability families equally can produce different overall rankings. Memory comparisons should report the relevant task family rather than relying only on an overall score dominated by other capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 基准指标只有与其观测接口和完成规则结合在一起才有意义。 表 3 为代表性的通用基准明确了这些要素。 「评估目标」一栏描述的是 rollout 所共同测试的能力，而最后一栏说明的是历史依赖性方面仍未解决的问题。 特别地，即使每一项都以百分比形式报告，目标谓词成功率、链完成度、答案准确率和部分进展分数也应保留各自不同的含义。 它们的聚合方式同样重要：对任务等权加权与对能力族等权加权可能产生不同的总体排名。 记忆比较应报告相关的任务族，而不应仅依赖于被其他能力主导的总体分数。

paragraphs.en: EMem-Bench [ 104 ] evaluates the use of supplied history during later physical interaction, rather than recall through a verbal answer alone. Its 2,554 episodes provide ordered multimodal history, a new task, and an executable action space. Four task families cover incidental visual evidence, changing world state, interaction-revealed constraints, and transfer of recurring corrections. Actions are executed in simulation; success requires the target terminal state, and the overall score equally averages family success rates. Error Recurrence Rate additionally counts repeated memory-related errors relative to decision opportunities. In the paper’s Dynamic Tracking example (Appendix C.8), a remote control moves from a drawer to an armchair before the target execution. Correct behavior retrieves it from the armchair, requiring the earlier location to be superseded (R2) while preserving object identity (R1). A return to the drawer is a stale-state choice; a failed pickup at the armchair can instead be an execution failure. The supplied history controls evidence availability but leaves autonomous acquisition and long-term continual learning outside this test.
paragraphs.zh: EMem-Bench [104] 评估的是在后续物理交互中使用所提供的历史记录，而不是仅通过口头回答来回忆。 其 2,554 个片段提供了有序的多模态历史、一个新任务以及一个可执行的动作空间。 四个任务族涵盖偶然的视觉证据、变化的世界状态、通过交互揭示的约束，以及反复纠正的迁移。 动作在仿真中执行；成功要求达到目标终止状态，总分对各族成功率取等权平均。 错误复现率还相对于决策机会统计重复出现的与记忆相关的错误。 在论文的动态追踪示例（附录 C.8）中，一个遥控器在目标执行之前从抽屉移动到了扶手椅上。 正确的行为是从扶手椅上取回它，这要求先前的位置被取代（R2），同时保持物体身份（R1）。 返回抽屉是过时状态的选择；而在扶手椅上拾取失败则可能是执行失败。 所提供的历史控制了证据的可得性，但将自主获取和长期持续学习排除在本测试之外。

paragraphs.en: This case makes temporal validity observable at the first location-dependent decision. Our proposed diagnostic is to pair plausible histories that end with different remote locations while matching the current view and task, then record the first chosen destination as well as terminal success. If that choice follows the latest supported location, the policy demonstrates use of updated historical state even when later execution fails. If the policy searches both locations indiscriminately and eventually succeeds, terminal success alone provides weaker evidence about revision. The benchmark’s recurrence measure is useful for this distinction, but it should be read alongside the actual action trace: it measures specific repeated errors under its event definitions rather than general memory confidence. These interpretations separate retention, supersession, and successful use without requiring a new architectural category.
paragraphs.zh: 该案例使时间有效性在第一个依赖位置的决策处即可被观察。 我们提出的诊断方法是：将结尾位于不同远程位置但当前视图与任务相匹配的合理历史成对组合，然后记录第一个被选择的目的地以及最终成败。 如果该选择遵循最新的受支持位置，则表明策略使用了更新后的历史状态，即使后续执行失败也是如此。 如果策略不加区分地搜索两个位置并最终成功，那么仅凭最终成功只能为修订能力提供较弱的证据。 该基准的重复性度量有助于做出这一区分，但应结合实际动作轨迹来解读：它度量的是其事件定义下的特定重复错误，而非一般性的记忆置信度。 这些解读在无需引入新的架构类别的情况下，区分了保留、取代和成功使用。

paragraphs.en: RoboDojo’s Memory split contains six tasks and is scored separately from its eight Long-Horizon tasks [ 113 ] . In match_and_pick_from_conveyor , an earlier object disappears and the policy must later pick a candidate of the same category. The retained variable is the reference category (R1), and the delayed candidate makes earlier evidence useful after it is absent (R4). Its standard simulation protocol uses 50 episodes per task; model experiments generally repeat evaluation across training seeds. It reports binary completion and a partial-progress score, then averages within capability splits and equally across the five splits overall. These outcomes test memory-conditioned manipulation, including visual discrimination and timely physical capture, rather than isolated category recall. The task is valuable because simply extending a workflow cannot resolve the missing reference. The distinct imitate_sorting_sequence task stresses remembered demonstration order, illustrating that the Memory split spans several historical variables rather than one retention mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: RoboDojo 的 Memory（记忆）拆分包含六个任务，并与它的八个 Long-Horizon（长时程）任务分开计分 [ 113 ]。 在 match_and_pick_from_conveyor 中，较早出现的物体会消失，策略必须在之后拾取同类别的一个候选物体。 被保留的变量是参考类别（R1），延迟出现的候选物体使得早先的证据在该物体消失后仍然有用（R4）。 其标准仿真协议对每个任务使用 50 个回合；模型实验通常在不同训练种子上重复评估。 它报告二值的完成情况和部分进度分数，然后在各能力拆分内部取平均，并在这五个拆分之间等权平均得到总体分数。 这些结果检验的是基于记忆条件下的操作，包括视觉辨别和及时的物理抓取，而非孤立的类别回忆。 该任务很有价值，因为仅仅扩展一个工作流无法解决参考信息缺失的问题。 独特的 imitate_sorting_sequence 任务强调对演示顺序的记忆，说明 Memory 拆分涵盖多个历史变量，而不只是一种保持机制。

paragraphs.en: The useful failure split is whether the robot selected the wrong category or failed to grasp a correctly selected moving object. Our proposed analysis records target selection before contact and then reports capture and final completion conditional on correct selection. Swapping the earlier reference while keeping later candidate observations comparable tests whether selection follows history; cue removal and a same-backbone context control test how much retention is needed. This would strengthen attribution beyond the published aggregate score. Partial progress can reveal where execution stopped, but its task-specific rubric is not a standalone memory-accuracy measure. Finally, this case concerns the simulation Memory split: RoboDojo’s separate real-world suite is a complementary deployment evaluation, not a set of matched physical replications of all six memory tasks. Keeping these interfaces explicit prevents a simulation recall result from being interpreted as complete real-world memory validation.

sents.en: The useful failure split is whether the robot selected the wrong category or failed to grasp a correctly selected moving object.

sents.en: Our proposed analysis records target selection before contact and then reports capture and final completion conditional on correct selection.
sents.zh: 我们提出的分析在接触之前记录目标选择，然后以正确选择为条件报告捕获和最终完成情况。

sents.en: Swapping the earlier reference while keeping later candidate observations comparable tests whether selection follows history; cue removal and a same-backbone context control test how much retention is needed.
sents.zh: 在保持后续候选观测可比的同时替换较早的参照，可以检验选择是否遵循历史；移除线索以及使用相同骨干网络的上下文对照，则检验需要多少保留量。

sents.en: This would strengthen attribution beyond the published aggregate score.
sents.zh: 这将使归因超越已发表的聚合分数而更有说服力。

sents.zh: 部分进度可以揭示执行在哪里停止，但其任务特定的评分标准并不是一个独立的记忆准确性度量。

paragraphs.en: Dedicated suites complement the two cases by controlling other historical variables. RMBench, RoboMME, MIKASA-Robo, RoboMemArena, LIBERO-Mem, MemoryBench, RoboTwin-MeM, MemMimic, ReMemBench, MemoryEQA, and LMEE introduce counting, occlusion, historical reference, delayed evidence, or exploration requirements [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 66 , 114 , 93 , 8 , 86 , 115 , 52 , 116 ] . MemTransfer instead varies starting pose, route availability, and historical relevance under a shared policy, helping assess reuse under changed conditions [ 85 ] . These protocol differences motivate the conservative requirement mapping in Table 4 : task coverage and indirect pressure should remain distinct from causal isolation of a memory computation.
paragraphs.zh: 专用测试套件通过控制其他历史变量来补充这两种情形。 RMBench、RoboMME、MIKASA-Robo、RoboMemArena、LIBERO-Mem、MemoryBench、RoboTwin-MeM、MemMimic、ReMemBench、MemoryEQA 和 LMEE 引入了计数、遮挡、历史引用、延迟证据或探索方面的要求 [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 66 , 114 , 93 , 8 , 86 , 115 , 52 , 116 ] 。 MemTransfer 则在共享策略下改变起始位姿、路线可用性和历史相关性，有助于评估条件变化下的复用能力 [ 85 ] 。 这些协议差异促成了表 4 中保守的需求映射：任务覆盖与间接压力应当与记忆计算的因果隔离保持区分。

sents.zh: 专用测试套件通过控制其他历史变量来补充这两种情形。

paragraphs.en: HuMeGo adds a whole-body setting in which observations preceding goal execution must support later actions [ 71 ] . We mark its object retention directly and state-change and selection demands conservatively: an object-guided keyframe protocol is informative about pre-history use without isolating open-ended prospective selection.
paragraphs.zh: HuMeGo 增加了一个全身场景，其中目标执行之前的观察必须支持后续动作 [71]。 我们直接标注其对象保持需求，并保守地标注状态变化与选择需求：对象引导的关键帧协议能够体现对历史信息的使用，但并不隔离开放式的前瞻性选择。

paragraphs.en: The strongest coverage currently lies in entity binding, state supersession, and task-state tracking. RoboMME, RoboMemArena, MIKASA-Robo, RMBench, and related benchmarks repeatedly test whether an observation, object state, interaction, or procedure remains available after the corresponding evidence disappears. This provides increasingly strong tests of episodic retention.
paragraphs.zh: 目前最强的覆盖在于实体绑定、状态取代和任务状态跟踪。 RoboMME、RoboMemArena、MIKASA-Robo、RMBench 及相关基准反复测试：当相应证据消失后，某个观察、对象状态、交互或过程是否仍然可用。 这为情景记忆的保持提供了越来越强的测试。

sents.en: The strongest coverage currently lies in entity binding, state supersession, and task-state tracking.
sents.zh: 目前最强的覆盖在于实体绑定、状态取代和任务状态跟踪。

sents.en: RoboMME, RoboMemArena, MIKASA-Robo, RMBench, and related benchmarks repeatedly test whether an observation, object state, interaction, or procedure remains available after the corresponding evidence disappears.
sents.zh: RoboMME、RoboMemArena、MIKASA-Robo、RMBench 及相关基准反复测试：当相应证据消失后，某个观察、对象状态、交互或过程是否仍然可用。

sents.en: This provides increasingly strong tests of episodic retention.
sents.zh: 这为情景记忆的保持提供了越来越强的测试。

paragraphs.en: In many of these tasks, the historical variable that deserves preservation is identifiable early. A demonstration specifies the relevant procedure, an occlusion event identifies the object to track, or the instruction explicitly indicates what should later be recalled. The resulting challenge is primarily to preserve known-relevant information over time.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些任务中的许多任务里，值得保留的历史变量在早期就可以被识别出来。 一段演示明确了相关过程，一次遮挡事件确定了要跟踪的对象，或者指令明确指出了之后应当回忆的内容。 由此产生的挑战主要是如何随时间保留已知相关的信息。

sents.en: In many of these tasks, the historical variable that deserves preservation is identifiable early.
sents.zh: 在这些任务中的许多任务里，值得保留的历史变量在早期就可以被识别出来。

sents.en: A demonstration specifies the relevant procedure, an occlusion event identifies the object to track, or the instruction explicitly indicates what should later be recalled.
sents.zh: 一段演示明确了相关过程，一次遮挡事件确定了要跟踪的对象，或者指令明确指出了之后应当回忆的内容。

sents.en: The resulting challenge is primarily to preserve known-relevant information over time.
sents.zh: 由此产生的挑战主要是如何随时间保留已知相关的信息。

paragraphs.en: Future-utility estimation moves the decision to an earlier stage. When an observation first appears, its eventual importance may still be unknown. RoboTwin-MeM begins to expose this problem through task-critical transient events [ 8 ] . ESI-Bench approaches a related selection problem from the perception side by asking agents to acquire observations that reduce uncertainty [ 103 ] . These two operations should be distinguished: information acquisition asks what the agent should observe, while information retention asks what among those observations should remain available. Current benchmarks provide stronger supervision for information acquisition and passive retention than for deciding prospectively which acquired observations deserve persistence.
paragraphs.zh: 未来效用估计将决策提前到了更早的阶段。 当一个观测首次出现时，其最终的重要性可能仍未知。 RoboTwin-MeM 开始通过任务关键的瞬态事件揭示这一问题 [ 8 ] 。 ESI-Bench 从感知侧切入一个相关的选择问题，要求智能体获取能够降低不确定性的观测 [ 103 ] 。 这两种操作应当加以区分：信息获取关心智能体应当观测什么，而信息保留则关心这些观测中哪些应保持可用。 当前的基准测试对信息获取和被动保留提供了比前瞻性判断哪些已获取的观测值得持久化更强的监督。

sents.en: Future-utility estimation moves the decision to an earlier stage.
sents.zh: 未来效用估计将决策提前到了更早的阶段。

sents.en: When an observation first appears, its eventual importance may still be unknown.
sents.zh: 当一个观测首次出现时，其最终的重要性可能仍未知。

sents.en: RoboTwin-MeM begins to expose this problem through task-critical transient events [ 8 ] .
sents.zh: RoboTwin-MeM 开始通过任务关键的瞬态事件揭示这一问题 [ 8 ] 。

sents.en: ESI-Bench approaches a related selection problem from the perception side by asking agents to acquire observations that reduce uncertainty [ 103 ] .
sents.zh: ESI-Bench 从感知侧切入一个相关的选择问题，要求智能体获取能够降低不确定性的观测 [ 103 ] 。

sents.en: These two operations should be distinguished: information acquisition asks what the agent should observe, while information retention asks what among those observations should remain available.
sents.zh: 这两种操作应当加以区分：信息获取关心智能体应当观测什么，而信息保留则关心这些观测中哪些应保持可用。

sents.zh: 当前的基准测试对信息获取和被动保留提供了比前瞻性判断哪些已获取的观测值得持久化更强的监督。

paragraphs.en: Belief calibration is also beginning to emerge as an evaluation pressure. ESI-Bench reports cases in which agents maintain an early hypothesis despite later contradictory observations [ 103 ] . LMEE similarly connects episodic memory with proactive exploration [ 116 ] . These settings probe whether historical information remains reliable after new evidence arrives. Dedicated metrics for memory confidence, staleness, and revision remain limited.
paragraphs.zh: 信念校准也开始成为一种评估压力。 ESI-Bench 报告了一些案例，其中智能体即使后来出现了相互矛盾的观察，仍然坚持早期的假设 [ 103 ] 。 LMEE 同样将情景记忆与主动探索联系起来 [ 116 ] 。 这些设置检验的是：当新证据出现后，历史信息是否仍然可靠。 针对记忆置信度、陈旧性与修订的专门指标仍然有限。

sents.en: Belief calibration is also beginning to emerge as an evaluation pressure.
sents.zh: 信念校准也开始成为一种评估压力。

sents.en: ESI-Bench reports cases in which agents maintain an early hypothesis despite later contradictory observations [ 103 ] .
sents.zh: ESI-Bench 报告了一些案例，其中智能体即使后来出现了相互矛盾的观察，仍然坚持早期的假设 [ 103 ] 。

sents.en: LMEE similarly connects episodic memory with proactive exploration [ 116 ] .
sents.zh: LMEE 同样将情景记忆与主动探索联系起来 [ 116 ] 。

sents.en: These settings probe whether historical information remains reliable after new evidence arrives.
sents.zh: 这些设置检验的是：当新证据出现后，历史信息是否仍然可靠。

sents.en: Dedicated metrics for memory confidence, staleness, and revision remain limited.
sents.zh: 针对记忆置信度、陈旧性与修订的专门指标仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: Experience abstraction has begun to receive targeted evaluation, but remains less comprehensively tested than within-episode retention. Most memory benchmarks operate within one episode and ask the agent to retain specific events or states. MemMimic provides initial cross-trial pressure [ 86 ] , while broader lifelong-learning benchmarks such as RoboCasa365 evaluate retention across sequential training phases [ 112 ] . EMem-Bench supplies controlled regularity-transfer tasks, and MemTransfer examines reuse when execution conditions differ [ 104 , 85 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 经验抽象已开始得到有针对性的评估，但其测试的全面性仍不及情景内记忆保持。 大多数记忆基准在单个情景内运行，要求智能体记住特定的事件或状态。 MemMimic 提供了初步的跨试次压力测试 [ 86 ]，而 RoboCasa365 等更广泛的终身学习基准则评估在连续训练阶段中的记忆保持 [ 112 ]。 EMem-Bench 提供受控的规律迁移任务，MemTransfer 则考察执行条件不同时的复用 [ 104 , 85 ]。

sents.en: Experience abstraction has begun to receive targeted evaluation, but remains less comprehensively tested than within-episode retention.
sents.zh: 经验抽象已开始得到有针对性的评估，但其测试的全面性仍不及情景内记忆保持。

sents.en: Most memory benchmarks operate within one episode and ask the agent to retain specific events or states.
sents.zh: 大多数记忆基准在单个情景内运行，要求智能体记住特定的事件或状态。

sents.en: MemMimic provides initial cross-trial pressure [ 86 ] , while broader lifelong-learning benchmarks such as RoboCasa365 evaluate retention across sequential training phases [ 112 ] .
sents.zh: MemMimic 提供了初步的跨试次压力测试 [ 86 ]，而 RoboCasa365 等更广泛的终身学习基准则评估在连续训练阶段中的记忆保持 [ 112 ]。

sents.en: EMem-Bench supplies controlled regularity-transfer tasks, and MemTransfer examines reuse when execution conditions differ [ 104 , 85 ] .
sents.zh: EMem-Bench 提供受控的规律迁移任务，MemTransfer 则考察执行条件不同时的复用 [ 104 , 85 ]。

paragraphs.en: These are useful initial tests, but neither alone establishes sustained improvement over an open-ended sequence of self-collected episodes. A stronger test of embodied experience abstraction would keep the base policy fixed and ask whether an evolving non-parametric memory can extract reusable regularities across episodes and improve later behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 这些是有用的初步测试，但单独任何一个都不能证明在开放式的一系列自采集情节上取得了持续的改进。 对具身经验抽象更有力的测试应当保持基础策略不变，并考察一个不断演化的非参数记忆能否跨情节提取可复用的规律，从而改进后续行为。

sents.en: These are useful initial tests, but neither alone establishes sustained improvement over an open-ended sequence of self-collected episodes.
sents.zh: 这些是有用的初步测试，但单独任何一个都不能证明在开放式的一系列自采集情节上取得了持续的改进。

sents.en: A stronger test of embodied experience abstraction would keep the base policy fixed and ask whether an evolving non-parametric memory can extract reusable regularities across episodes and improve later behavior.

paragraphs.en: The benchmark audit reveals a clear imbalance in current coverage. Entity binding, state supersession, and task-state tracking receive comparatively direct evaluation in RoboMME, RoboMemArena, MIKASA-Robo, RMBench, and related suites. Future-utility estimation appears in early form through transient-event and information-selection settings, while belief calibration is only indirectly probed through contradictory evidence, active sensing, or exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准审计揭示了当前评测覆盖中的明显失衡。 实体绑定、状态取代和任务状态追踪在 RoboMME、RoboMemArena、MIKASA-Robo、RMBench 及相关评测套件中得到了相对直接的评估。 未来效用估计通过瞬态事件和信息选择类设定以早期形式出现，而信念校准则只能通过矛盾证据、主动感知或探索进行间接探测。

sents.en: The benchmark audit reveals a clear imbalance in current coverage.
sents.zh: 该基准审计揭示了当前评测覆盖中的明显失衡。

sents.en: Entity binding, state supersession, and task-state tracking receive comparatively direct evaluation in RoboMME, RoboMemArena, MIKASA-Robo, RMBench, and related suites.
sents.zh: 实体绑定、状态取代和任务状态追踪在 RoboMME、RoboMemArena、MIKASA-Robo、RMBench 及相关评测套件中得到了相对直接的评估。

sents.en: Future-utility estimation appears in early form through transient-event and information-selection settings, while belief calibration is only indirectly probed through contradictory evidence, active sensing, or exploration.
sents.zh: 未来效用估计通过瞬态事件和信息选择类设定以早期形式出现，而信念校准则只能通过矛盾证据、主动感知或探索进行间接探测。

paragraphs.en: Cross-episode experience abstraction remains less thoroughly isolated in benchmark suites: EMem-Bench and MemTransfer add controlled generalization and transfer tests, but sustained consolidation over self-collected episodes remains underexplored, while broader lifelong-learning suites often conflate memory with continued parameter learning.
paragraphs.zh: 跨情景的经验抽象在基准套件中的隔离程度仍不够彻底：EMem-Bench 和 MemTransfer 增加了受控的泛化与迁移测试，但对自收集情景之上的持续巩固仍研究不足，而更广泛的生命终身学习套件则常将记忆与持续的参数学习混为一谈。

paragraphs.en: Method-level longitudinal evaluations are also becoming more concrete: PAM [ 83 ] revises assistance memory across days, while EmbodiedEvo [ 82 ] freezes acquired experience for independent test agents. These protocols answer different questions about revision and transfer. Benchmark coverage should therefore record whether evaluation continues to update shared memory, rather than labeling both settings as equivalent continual learning.
paragraphs.zh: 方法层面的纵向评估也正变得更加具体：PAM [ 83 ] 跨多天修订辅助记忆，而 EmbodiedEvo [ 82 ] 则冻结已获得的经验，供独立的测试智能体使用。 这些协议回答的是关于修订与迁移的不同问题。 因此，基准覆盖范围应记录评估是否继续更新共享记忆，而不是将两种设置都标记为等价的持续学习。

sents.en: Method-level longitudinal evaluations are also becoming more concrete: PAM [ 83 ] revises assistance memory across days, while EmbodiedEvo [ 82 ] freezes acquired experience for independent test agents.
sents.zh: 方法层面的纵向评估也正变得更加具体：PAM [ 83 ] 跨多天修订辅助记忆，而 EmbodiedEvo [ 82 ] 则冻结已获得的经验，供独立的测试智能体使用。

sents.en: These protocols answer different questions about revision and transfer.
sents.zh: 这些协议回答的是关于修订与迁移的不同问题。

sents.en: Benchmark coverage should therefore record whether evaluation continues to update shared memory, rather than labeling both settings as equivalent continual learning.
sents.zh: 因此，基准覆盖范围应记录评估是否继续更新共享记忆，而不是将两种设置都标记为等价的持续学习。

paragraphs.en: A second gap concerns diagnostic attribution. General-purpose benchmarks can create substantial memory pressure while still mixing memory with perception, planning, manipulation, generalization, and recovery. Even dedicated memory benchmarks can permit current-state leakage or provide scaffolding that externalizes part of the historical state. Accordingly, Section 6 turns from describing existing benchmarks to the separate question of what evidence is needed to establish genuine memory use.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个缺口涉及诊断归因问题。 通用基准测试可能造成显著的记忆压力，同时仍将记忆与感知、规划、操作、泛化和恢复混杂在一起。 即使是专门的记忆基准测试，也可能允许当前状态泄漏，或提供将部分历史状态外化的脚手架。 因此，第 6 节将从描述现有基准测试转向另一个独立问题：要证明真正使用了记忆，需要什么样的证据。

sents.en: A second gap concerns diagnostic attribution.
sents.zh: 第二个缺口涉及诊断归因问题。

sents.en: General-purpose benchmarks can create substantial memory pressure while still mixing memory with perception, planning, manipulation, generalization, and recovery.
sents.zh: 通用基准测试可能造成显著的记忆压力，同时仍将记忆与感知、规划、操作、泛化和恢复混杂在一起。

sents.en: Even dedicated memory benchmarks can permit current-state leakage or provide scaffolding that externalizes part of the historical state.

sents.en: Accordingly, Section 6 turns from describing existing benchmarks to the separate question of what evidence is needed to establish genuine memory use.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation should begin by establishing that a particular decision requires historical information. The paired-state criterion in Eq. ( 5 ) provides a constructive test: keep the goal and current observation comparable, vary a plausible preceding history, and require a different correct action. Current-observation, bounded-context, full-history, and persistent-memory policies should then be compared under matched backbones, observation privileges, and execution interfaces. Full history provides an access reference but still requires successful reasoning, while a memory-augmented policy may benefit from extra computation or training. This makes task construction and experimental controls equally necessary. The two cases in Sec. 5.3 illustrate the distinction: EMem-Bench exposes whether a policy chooses a location justified by updated history, and RoboDojo exposes whether a remembered reference controls physical target selection. paragraphs.en: Diagnostic interventions should match the historical variable and distinguish failure stages. Entity-history swaps test R1; newly contradicted locations test R2; visually matched phases with different completed counts test R3; a query revealed only after a capacity-limited write phase tests R4; varying evidence reliability with optional costly re-observation tests R5; and held-out situations with exceptions to a learned rule test R6. For prospective selection, explicitly announcing the future target changes the problem to retention of known-relevant evidence. Likewise, conflicting timestamps alone do not measure calibrated uncertainty: confidence and information-seeking must respond to reliability and environmental change. CanTest offers a related capability-level approach, using generated tests and separate perception, memory, planning, and decision oracles for VLN [ 117 ] . Its memory oracle compares explicit memory descriptions with historical visual annotations, so it supplies an attribution tool while leaving latent memory and the action-level necessity of every recalled detail partly unresolved. Combining intermediate-state inspection with plausible history interventions can localize selection, retrieval, revision, and execution errors more convincingly than either technique alone.
paragraphs.zh: 诊断性干预应与历史变量相匹配，并区分失败阶段。 实体-历史交换测试 R1；新近被矛盾的位置测试 R2；视觉上匹配但完成计数不同的阶段测试 R3；仅在容量受限的写入阶段之后才揭示的查询测试 R4；在可选的高成本重新观察下改变证据可靠性测试 R5；而对已学习规则存在例外的保留情境测试 R6。 对于前瞻性选择，明确宣布未来目标会将问题转变为对已知相关证据的保留。 同样，仅有冲突的时间戳并不能衡量经校准的不确定性：置信度和信息寻求必须对可靠性和环境变化作出响应。 CanTest 提供了一种相关的能力级别方法，为视觉语言导航（VLN）使用生成的测试以及独立的感知、记忆、规划和决策裁决器 [ 117 ] 。 其记忆裁决器将显式记忆描述与历史视觉标注进行比较，因此它提供了一种归因工具，但对潜在记忆以及每条被回忆细节在动作层面的必要性仍部分未解决。 将中间状态检查与合理的历史干预相结合，能够比单独使用任一技术更有说服力地定位选择、检索、修订和执行错误。

paragraphs.en: Memory quality should be reported jointly with its temporal reach and deployment cost. Performance curves over cue-to-use delay, distractor load, object count, and state changes reveal which information is lost as demands increase. Measured duration should also be varied independently of frame count, as motivated by Temporal Flow Policy [ 67 ] . Storage, retrieval latency, update latency, policy latency, and interaction cost reveal the resources used to preserve it. TacitVLA’s concurrent generation of entries for future ledger use illustrates why write scheduling matters alongside representational capacity [ 95 ] . A representation that preserves a useful cue but delays control can be unsuitable for moving-object capture, whereas the same latency may be acceptable in household planning. Hybrid systems additionally need component-specific ablations and conflict tests to establish whether different stores contribute complementary evidence and maintain consistent state. Proposed interventions should also preserve plausible histories wherever possible: arbitrary shuffling can create malformed inputs and introduce a distribution shift unrelated to forgetting. These controls connect claims about efficiency and specialization to the actual historical variable under test.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆质量应当与其时间覆盖范围和部署成本一并报告。 提示到使用延迟、干扰负载、物体数量和状态变化上的性能曲线，揭示了随着需求增加哪些信息会丢失。 测量时长还应独立于帧数进行变化，正如 Temporal Flow Policy [67] 所论证的那样。 存储、检索延迟、更新延迟、策略延迟和交互成本揭示了为保存记忆所使用的资源。 TacitVLA 为未来台账使用而并发生成条目的做法，说明了为什么写入调度与表示能力同样重要 [95]。 一种保留了有用线索但延迟控制的表示，可能不适合运动物体抓取，而同样的延迟在家庭任务规划中或许是可以接受的。 混合系统还需要针对组件的消融实验和冲突测试，以确定不同的存储是否贡献了互补的证据并保持一致的状态。 所提出的干预还应尽可能保留合理的历史：任意打乱可能产生格式错误的输入，并引入与遗忘无关的分布偏移。 这些对照将关于效率和专业化的论断与被测的实际历史变量联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Cross-episode evaluation should specify what persists and demonstrate transfer beyond the acquired cases. Each protocol must state which memory resets, whether the policy or expert heads are updated, how acquisition and evaluation scenes differ, and whether new test experience enters the shared store. Robota-Embed’s stage-sensitive continuation retrieval and EmbodiedEvo’s frozen inherited Skills and Lessons illustrate distinct ways for experience to influence later execution [ 81 , 82 ] . Their relevance to sustained improvement depends on the persistence protocol, not the label attached to the system. Useful controls include a frozen archive, an expanding unprocessed archive, matched acquisition budgets, and tests with conflicting or obsolete experience. Transfer should improve held-out decisions while limiting regression on earlier conditions. Across temporal scales, this yields three research priorities: selecting useful evidence before its eventual query is known, preserving history while revising current beliefs, and consolidating reusable knowledge with its applicability conditions. Progress on these priorities can turn memory from an additional input channel into a dependable state-maintenance capability for embodied deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 跨回合评估应明确哪些内容得以持续保留，并展示超越已习得案例的迁移能力。 每个协议必须说明哪些记忆被重置、策略或专家头是否被更新、采集场景与评估场景有何差异，以及新的测试经验是否进入共享存储库。 Robota-Embed 的阶段敏感的续接检索与 EmbodiedEvo 的冻结继承技能与经验教训，展示了经验影响后续执行的两种不同方式 [ 81 , 82 ] 。 它们与持续改进的相关性取决于持久化协议，而非系统所附带的标签。 有效的对照包括冻结的存档、不断扩展的未处理存档、匹配的采集预算，以及包含冲突或过时经验的测试。 迁移应能在提升留出决策质量的同时，限制对早期条件的性能回退。 跨时间尺度来看，这带来了三个研究优先事项：在最终查询尚未确定之前选取有用的证据、在修订当前信念的同时保留历史，以及将可复用知识及其适用条件进行整合。 在这些优先事项上取得进展，可以让记忆从额外的输入通道转变为面向具身部署的可靠状态维护能力。

paragraphs.en: Embodied memory supports action by preserving decision-relevant information after its originating evidence leaves the current observation. This survey organized that role through six overlapping requirements: hidden world state, action-induced state change, task state, delayed-relevance evidence, active belief maintenance, and cross-episode experience. A separate architectural axis compared eight design categories, comprising seven recurring mechanism or organization families and hybrid composition. Their relationship is many-to-many: a requirement can be served by different representations, and one implementation can support several requirements. Making this distinction explicit connects architectural choices to the information that a task actually needs, while avoiding an ambiguous enumeration of memory types.
paragraphs.zh: 具身记忆通过在原始证据离开当前观测后保留与决策相关的信息来支持行动。 本综述通过六项相互重叠的需求来组织这一角色：隐藏的世界状态、行动引起的状态变化、任务状态、延迟相关证据、主动的信念维护，以及跨回合经验。 另一个独立的架构维度比较了八类设计，包括七个反复出现的机制或组织类别，以及混合组合。 它们之间是多对多的关系：一项需求可以由不同的表示来满足，而一个实现也可以支持多项需求。 明确这一区分将架构选择与任务实际需要的信息联系起来，同时避免了对记忆类型进行模糊的枚举。

paragraphs.en: The comparison yields three principal conclusions. First, retention, access, and temporal validity are separate sources of success and failure: an agent can preserve a historical observation perfectly and still act incorrectly because that observation is obsolete or retrieved in the wrong context. Second, representation should be selected according to tolerable information loss and required access, with compact latent state, visual detail, symbolic structure, spatial grounding, and reusable experience serving different decision demands. Hybrid composition adds value when these capabilities are coordinated and experimentally attributable. Third, benchmark scores support claims only within their observation and execution protocols. The EMem-Bench and RoboDojo cases expose different uses of history: selecting an action from updated world state and converting a remembered visual reference into robot control. Their scoring protocols also show why aggregate success combines memory with perception, planning, and execution.
paragraphs.zh: 这一比较得出了三个主要结论。 第一，留存、访问与时效有效性是成功与失败的不同来源：智能体可以完美地保存一条历史观察，却仍因该观察已过时或在错误上下文中被检索而作出错误行动。 第二，表征应根据可容忍的信息损失和所需的访问方式来选择，紧凑潜状态、视觉细节、符号结构、空间定位和可复用经验分别服务于不同的决策需求。 只有当这些能力得到协调且在实验上可归因时，混合组合才能带来价值。 第三，基准测试分数只能在其观察与执行协议范围内支持相关论断。 EMem-Bench 和 RoboDojo 两个案例展示了历史的不同用途：从更新后的世界状态中选择动作，以及将记忆中的视觉参考转化为机器人控制。 它们的评分协议也表明，为什么总体成功率将记忆与感知、规划和执行结合在了一起。

sents.zh: 这一比较得出了三个主要结论。

sents.en: First, retention, access, and temporal validity are separate sources of success and failure: an agent can preserve a historical observation perfectly and still act incorrectly because that observation is obsolete or retrieved in the wrong context.
sents.zh: 第一，留存、访问与时效有效性是成功与失败的不同来源：智能体可以完美地保存一条历史观察，却仍因该观察已过时或在错误上下文中被检索而作出错误行动。

sents.en: Second, representation should be selected according to tolerable information loss and required access, with compact latent state, visual detail, symbolic structure, spatial grounding, and reusable experience serving different decision demands.
sents.zh: 第二，表征应根据可容忍的信息损失和所需的访问方式来选择，紧凑潜状态、视觉细节、符号结构、空间定位和可复用经验分别服务于不同的决策需求。

sents.en: Hybrid composition adds value when these capabilities are coordinated and experimentally attributable.
sents.zh: 只有当这些能力得到协调且在实验上可归因时，混合组合才能带来价值。

sents.en: Third, benchmark scores support claims only within their observation and execution protocols.
sents.zh: 第三，基准测试分数只能在其观察与执行协议范围内支持相关论断。

sents.en: The EMem-Bench and RoboDojo cases expose different uses of history: selecting an action from updated world state and converting a remembered visual reference into robot control.
sents.zh: EMem-Bench 和 RoboDojo 两个案例展示了历史的不同用途：从更新后的世界状态中选择动作，以及将记忆中的视觉参考转化为机器人控制。

sents.en: Their scoring protocols also show why aggregate success combines memory with perception, planning, and execution.
sents.zh: 它们的评分协议也表明，为什么总体成功率将记忆与感知、规划和执行结合在了一起。

paragraphs.en: The field’s next challenge is to make retained experience dependable under changing tasks and environments. This requires selecting useful evidence before all future queries are known, revising beliefs when actions or observations invalidate them, and transferring accumulated experience without losing its applicability conditions. The literature and benchmark coverage reviewed here remain uneven, and the proposed framework is a diagnostic synthesis rather than an exhaustive or mutually exclusive taxonomy. Nevertheless, it offers a common basis for stronger comparisons: identify the missing historical variable, specify how the system maintains it, and demonstrate under controlled interventions that it improves the later decision. Progress on these criteria would make memory a more reliable foundation for embodied agents that operate beyond isolated episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 该领域的下一个挑战是让被保留的经验在不断变化的任务与环境中保持可靠。 这要求在所有未来查询尚不可知的情况下就选出有用的证据，在动作或观察使既有信念失效时对其进行修正，并在迁移积累的经验时不丢失其适用条件。 本文所综述的文献与基准覆盖仍不均衡，且所提出的框架是一种诊断性综合，而非穷尽的或互斥的分类体系。 尽管如此，它为更有力的比较提供了一个共同基础：识别缺失的历史变量，说明系统如何维护该变量，并在受控干预下证明它能改善后续决策。 在这些标准上取得进展，将使记忆成为在孤立情节之外运作的具身智能体更可靠的基础。
